description: Held-out check for the prompt change of #20. Written after the new rules, never used to design them, and never shown to the model as an example. It tests the same four kinds of failure the main set revealed (a missing or wrong preposition after a verb or adjective, a wrong word choice, a correct sentence about other people or the story, an unrelated sentence) with new sentences, so before/after on this set shows whether the change generalises.

labelling.status: draft: every label needs a second team member's review before the results are final
